**380 commits, 16 user-facing changes.** Draft written to [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

Three breaking ones. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is gone. Error types are no longer re-exported.

| Bucket | Commits |
|---|---|
| Dep bumps | 114, all patch or minor |
| Refactor, test, ci, chore | 245 |
| Real changes | 21 |

Two calls I made for you. Perf sits under `Fixed` since you allow three headings only. I dated it `2026-08-30`.

Next: check the minimum Node version. Docs and `.nvmrc` moved, `package.json` `engines` did not.
